title: music-ai-skill-studio intake document
description: Schema for the `--intake` / `--intake-file` document accepted by the plan, batch and verify-intake commands. Only `goal` and `inputs` are required; everything else tunes the generated case.

goal.description: One sentence describing the outcome the case must produce.

inputs.description: What already exists: files, recordings, stems, briefs, references, data. String (semicolon-separated) or array.

constraints.description: Hard limits: deadlines, format, budget, prohibited techniques, platform policy.

references.description: Artists, tracks or works to describe stylistically. References are analysed for traits, never imitated.

platform.description: Target platform or channel, e.g. Spotify, TikTok, film cue sheet.

tempo_bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, 20-400. Number or numeric string.

key.description: e.g. F# minor, Bb major, D dorian.

duration.description: Target length containing a number, e.g. 3:30 or 210s.

stem_format.description: Requested stem layout, e.g. 24-bit/48kHz WAV, 8 stems.

rights_status.description: unknown, pending and restricted produce blocking flags.

voice_consent.description: missing and pending produce blocking flags; consent must name the speaker and the permitted scope.

model.description: Generation or analysis model used, for provenance.

seed.description: Seed or settings string, for reproducibility.

prompt.description: The prompt actually used, recorded verbatim.

actions.description: Requested sensitive actions. Each requires a matching --approve token: release_publish -> APPROVE-RELEASE, rights_signing -> APPROVE-RIGHTS, payment -> APPROVE-PAYMENT, credential_use -> APPROVE-CREDENTIALS, irreversible_delete -> APPROVE-DELETE.
